metaTitle: Deep Cleaning in Burbank, CA | Cost & What's Included
metaDescription: Deep cleaning for Burbank homes costs $200–$365. See what's included, common trouble spots in older homes, and when to call a pro.
intro: If your Burbank home hasn't had a thorough scrub in a while, grime tends to build up in places a weekly wipe-down never reaches. This is especially true in the city's post-war single-family homes, where original tile, older fixtures, and aging grout lines trap dirt that regular cleaning can't lift. A deep clean targets those overlooked areas and resets the whole house.
causes: Regular cleaning routines usually skip baseboards, window tracks, and behind appliances, letting dust and grease build up over months.
Original plumbing fixtures in many Burbank homes have porous or worn finishes that hold onto soap scum and mineral deposits more than newer fixtures would.
Older grout and caulk lines in kitchens and bathrooms absorb grease and moisture, creating buildup that a surface wipe won't remove.
Pets, kids, or recent renovation dust can accelerate grime accumulation in carpets, vents, and corners.
Long gaps between move-ins, move-outs, or seasonal cleanings let dust settle into areas like ceiling fans, light fixtures, and closet shelving.
whatProDoes: Dust and wipe down all surfaces including baseboards, window sills, ceiling fans, and light fixtures from top to bottom.
Scrub kitchen surfaces, including inside the microwave, exterior of appliances, and grease buildup around the stove and range hood.
Deep clean bathrooms, focusing on grout, tile, and around older fixtures where soap scum and mineral deposits tend to concentrate.
Vacuum and mop all flooring, including edges and corners, and clean interior windows and tracks where dust collects.
Detail hard-to-reach spots like behind furniture, inside cabinets if requested, and closet shelving.
diyOrPro: A deep clean is generally safe to DIY if you have the time and don't mind tackling grout, appliance interiors, and high or awkward spots yourself. It becomes worth hiring a pro when the job spans multiple rooms, involves years of buildup, or you simply want a thorough result without dedicating a full weekend to it. There's no safety concern here beyond standard care with cleaning chemicals in enclosed spaces like bathrooms.
priceNote: Deep cleaning in Burbank runs $200 to $365, based on a $56 hourly rate and jobs typically taking 3 to 6 hours. The exact time depends on the size of your home, how many rooms need attention, and how much buildup has accumulated, particularly in kitchens and bathrooms with original fixtures.

faqs.q: How is a deep clean different from a regular cleaning?
faqs.a: Regular cleaning covers surface-level tidying like dusting and vacuuming, while a deep clean goes further into baseboards, grout, appliance interiors, window tracks, and other spots that get skipped week to week.

faqs.q: Will a deep clean remove mineral deposits from old fixtures?
faqs.a: A pro can significantly reduce soap scum and mineral buildup on original fixtures using appropriate cleaning products, though heavily etched or permanently stained finishes may not come back to like-new condition.

faqs.q: Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?
faqs.a: This depends on the specific pro or service you book through Tarea, so confirm what's included when you schedule so there are no surprises on the day of the job.
